Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "类别是接收方自身的雇员、管理人员和董事，不包括关联方人员。", "name": "recipient_own_employees_officers_directors"}, {"meaning": "类别是接收方自身的雇员、董事和承包服务人员。", "name": "recipient_own_employees_directors_contractors"}, {"meaning": "类别是接收方关联方的管理人员、董事和雇员，所有权链不得扁平化。", "name": "recipient_affiliate_officers_directors_employees"}, {"meaning": "类别是一般第三方，而非仅限于明确列举且受条件约束的服务人员。", "name": "unrestricted_third_parties"}, {"meaning": "单元没有上述明确类别，或其类别不能由当前选择准确表达。", "name": "other_recipient_scope"}], "examples": [{"choice": "recipient_affiliate_officers_directors_employees", "quote": "Recipient may disclose Discloser’s Confidential Information to Recipient’s affiliates on the condition that Recipient shall restrict access to Discloser’s Confidential Information to those of Recipient’s affiliates’ officers, directors and employees who have a legitimate need-to-know to carry out the Purpose and who are obligated to protect such Confidential Information pursuant to terms and conditions no less protective of Discloser than those contained in this Agreement and Recipient shall be liable for any failure of its affiliates to abide by the provisions of this Agreement as if such failure was the act or omission of such party.", "source": "ContractNLI:4d4e550ac17660215ea791c0b3a37cbef136c2e7642e6cbeb3cc9a3df43eeb40"}, {"choice": "recipient_own_employees_officers_directors", "quote": "(c) to restrict access to Confidential Information to those of its officers, directors and employees who have a legitimate need-to-know to carry out the Purpose and who are obligated to protect such Confidential Information pursuant to terms and conditions no less protective of Discloser than those contained in this Agreement; and", "source": "ContractNLI:4d4e550ac17660215ea791c0b3a37cbef136c2e7642e6cbeb3cc9a3df43eeb40"}, {"choice": "recipient_own_employees_directors_contractors", "quote": "(c) not to disclose the same whether to its employees or to third parties except in confidence to such of its employees, directors or contractors who need to know the same for the Purpose and that (i) such employees, directors and contractors are obliged by their contracts of employment or services not to disclose the same, (ii) the receiving party shall enforce such obligations at its expense and at the request of the disclosing party in so far as breach thereof relates to the disclosing party's Confidential Information;", "source": "ContractNLI:d9360f2a8c03efc35524289167a83e9505ebae476367505b868af29f37fcffa0"}], "name": "disclosure_recipient_scope", "question": "确定最后一个单元中实际获得许可或被禁止的接收者类别。必须保持所有权链：关联方的雇员不是接收方自己的雇员；仅选择文本明确列出的类别。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_recipient_scope|unit|42", "operation": "disclosure_recipient_scope", "unit_ids": [42], "current_units": [{"id": 42, "text": "(k) Make sure that all the employees and/or consultants engaged to undertake any audit on its behalf have signed the mandatory non-disclosure agreement."}], "focus_unit_id": 42}, {"id": "disclosure_recipient_scope|unit|62", "operation": "disclosure_recipient_scope", "unit_ids": [62], "current_units": [{"id": 62, "text": "Auditor shall restrict disclosure of such Confidential Information to its employees and/or consultants with a need to know (and advise such employees and/or consultants of the obligations assumed herein), shall use the Confidential Information only for the purposes set forth in the Agreement, and shall not disclose such Confidential Information to any affiliates, subsidiaries, associates and/or third party without prior written approval of the Auditee."}], "focus_unit_id": 62}]}
